-name: Update Client Head Mapping in Revenue Cube

comment.#cdata-section:
This job is initiated by the user from the RVP2 (Client Head Mapping report) to update the client head mapping in Snowflake, refresh the total estimate input fields, and load the new estimates by month into the input field as well.
